body:
Independent follow-up to the preserved W07 two-owner review, manifest SHA256 `fa86b7a9bdc84ae7e796d2dcb507d2dd031a0f8c1462492a45bff2fdfb00c04c`. I rehashed all2,339 manifest-listed files, rebound both reviewed candidates to the active37-candidate set, inspected the exact primary sections and reproduced native synonym/row behavior. These are unapplied candidates. Original reviews, histories and genuine scope holds remain; neither review nor this triage approves release.

The active combined `Polypeptone.yaml` candidate SHA256 `13e635961c13a15555bc3b526c7f83e0af148c2dc87a23ff0a273cace16f3b93` preserves both exact W05/W06 origins and the supported Hipolypepton alias exclusions. Two residual findings require bounded follow-up, without reviving the old false casein-plus-soy premise.

**POLYPEPTONE-001 — missing broader grounding.** The candidate replaces the old parent-as-identity with `kgmicrobe.ingredient:polypeptone`, but `ontology_mapping` points only to that same local identity with FALLBACK_REGISTRY. An actual native projection emits only its exact registry row. [MAPPING_SEMANTICS §3 step3](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/blob/main/MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md) requires a separate supported nearest broader parent. Captured OLS verifies FOODON:03315306 `protein hydrolyzates`; the [Thermo manufacturer guide](https://assets.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/BPD/brochures/peptones-supplements-feeds-technical-reference-guide.pdf), printedp49, describes equal parts pancreatic casein digest and peptic animal-tissue digest. After settling the owner’s product scope, retain the distinct local identity and add the supported broader protein-hydrolysate relation (`NARROW_MATCH` giving `skos:broadMatch`), plus its exact registry row. Cite a closer verified parent if one is established. Do not restore a generic parent as the product identity or an unsupported closeMatch. This is material-to-broader-material grounding, not #294’s unresolved preparation-to-anatomical-source question.

**POLYPEPTONE-002 — unresolved Japanese labels still resolve.** `Polypepton (Nihon Pharm. Co.)` remains CATALOG_VARIANT and `Polypepton (Nihon Seiyaku)` remains RAW_TEXT; both native MIM/Claw policies resolve them. The note withholding a BD assignment does not change those global resolver-bearing fields. The exact supplied CultureMech:008313 context (`TOGO_M174_Horikoshi-I_Medium.yaml`, SHA256 `e2fbb3da855e4906cc877e7c77fbce8fc94c602c4710247215ad78a9eeeab261`) names Nihon Pharm. Co. at ingredients[1] and cites JCM181. The complete captured [JCM181](https://www.jcm.riken.jp/cgi-bin/jcm/jcm_grmd?GRMD=181) names Hipolypepton(FUJIFILM Wako); [Wako’s manufacturer catalog](https://labchem-wako.fujifilm.com/us/catalog/pdf/catalog_0005.pdf), printedp8, distinguishes unsuffixed casein-derived material from soybean S/N/NS variants. The Thermo comparator is casein/animal-tissue blend. This is a concrete routing conflict, not proof every Japanese label denotes a particular Wako SKU or that a current recipe replacement proves historical identity.

Reconcile that exact source family and the remaining Japanese occurrences from actual product/history evidence. Retain all raw labels and the unresolved historical bridge; do not force all labels to BD211910, invent a wholesale owner merger, or reject them solely because catalogue names differ. Where evidence does not settle a label, keep an explicit source/identity hold and prevent unqualified alias/whole-owner approval. Record the precise disposition on an immutable successor. The supported three Hipolypepton exclusions remain intact.

The reviewer’s all150 context-row routing table is a complete supplied-context assessment, not new primary approval of150recipes or a replacement for the dated135 occurrence statistic. The guide is copyright2019 with2018 acquisition context; candidate wording CurrentBD must not be treated as verified2026 procurement information. Use the dated source description if updating that wording.

Preserve #718’s mapping/source-owner WITHHOLD. Exact historical ledger key2318 is a mapping disposition, with older baseline_position2326; it is not a role assertion or current SSSOM line. The inherited PROTEIN_SOURCE0.8 remains independently unapproved because its evidence is provisional name-pattern inference. Parent anchoring, raw-alias cleanup and native schema success do not approve roles, source applicability or release.

Native review `20261108T071451Z-worker07-polypeptone-independent`, YAML SHA256 `70f2d966ae7f9630f7f86e8d057176ba3a78609390748b63ae4e4d8e5b2ddeee`. Independent triage proofs are `C/preflight/fac-polypeptone-findings-triage-v1/{native-reproduction,jcm181-source-context,hold-ledger-independent-binding}.json`. Fresh full #1202/#294/#718 context was read; this comment extends the existing product-boundary issue rather than creating a duplicate.
